tools.name: lookup_bin
tools.description: BIN / IIN lookup (card BIN checker). Returns the card network (Visa, Mastercard, Amex and others), card type (credit, debit, prepaid), card level, issuing bank and country for the first 6 to 8 digits of a card number. Use it to identify a card or where it was issued. Never pass a full card number.

tools.name: lookup_issuer
tools.description: Find card issuing banks by name, with their country, website and phone number. Accepts partial or misspelled names. Use it to confirm the bank behind a card or to find how to contact an issuer.

tools.name: lookup_mcc
tools.description: Merchant category code (MCC) lookup. Pass a 4-digit MCC for its full definition (category group, high-risk flag, Visa and Mastercard definitions), or describe a business (for example "grocery store" or "software") to find the matching MCC.

tools.name: lookup_decline_code
tools.description: Explain why a card payment was declined or failed. Accepts a decline code, response code, refusal reason or error message (for example "51", "05", "do_not_honor" or "insufficient funds") from card networks and processors such as Visa, Mastercard, Stripe and Adyen. Optionally narrow by provider.
